$comment: Minimum number of tests each suite must actually run, asserted by
tools/check-test-count.mjs. A green exit code is not evidence that a
suite ran. Measured on Node 24.21: `node --test test/` runs 0 real
tests and exits 1, but `node --test 'test/*.nope.ts'` runs 0 tests and
exits 0. One typo in a glob turns a whole suite into a silent green.
Raise a number here when you add tests. Never lower one to make CI
green: a drop means tests stopped being discovered or stopped existing,
and both are the failure this gate is for.

suites.note: ALC-1 conformance, admissibility and comparison suites.
